svg.title: Font Manager Pro, version 3.6.0: a Windows font manager that never deletes a font file. Sample, waterfall and glyph previews, previews of uninstalled fonts, duplicate and health checks, OpenType comparison and pairing, and export to font packs, @font-face CSS and WOFF2. Single .exe, no admin rights for normal use.
svg.text: Preview, install and inspect fonts, safely.

g.text: Never deletes a font: uninstall only deregisters, with backup
Sample, waterfall and glyph previews from 10 to 200 px
Previews fonts you haven't installed, straight from the file
Duplicate and missing-file checks, per-font health score
OpenType comparison, similar fonts and pairing ideas
Exports font packs, @font-face CSS and WOFF2 subsets
